construct: input whose VALUE ink and ::placeholder ink are different colours
why: RC7. The emitter mints an empty placeholder string in VALUE ink, so every empty field reads as filled. This case measures the INPUT to that defect: the control element carries its value ink and nothing else, because the ::placeholder plane is a separately named wall (see the pseudo-placeholder case). spec/channel-table.json classes color CARRIED (the text node fill).

canvas.note: the text node fill of the control — the ink the emitter reaches for when no placeholder-color is carried
